title: The proposed changes drop Ruby 2.5 support, and leave Ruby 2.7 as the only default (we are going ahead of Debian here).
description:
The proposed changes drop Ruby 2.5 support, and leave Ruby 2.7 as the only default (we are going ahead of Debian here).

autopkgtest is happy (I found an issue in the tests declaration and I'll apply my changes in Debian as well):

autopkgtest [16:52:14]: @@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@ summary
smoke-test           PASS
ruby-all-dev         PASS
command1             PASS

PPA with the proposed package:

https://launchpad.net/~lucaskanashiro/+archive/ubuntu/focal-ruby-defaults-drop-2.5/+packages
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 1d1a377..1300c0c 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,14 @@
+ruby-defaults (1:2.7.0ubuntu1) focal; urgency=medium
+
+  * Support only Ruby 2.7, drop Ruby 2.5 support
+    - ruby_debian_dev.rb: drop ruby2.5 has_support_for block
+    - d/rules: update DEBIAN_DEFAULT_RUBY_VERSION to 2.7
+  * Make DEP-8 tests depend on the generated binaries instead of the
+    ones available in the archive
+  * d/control: update from ruby2.5 to ruby2.7 in Depends and Description
+
+ -- Lucas Kanashiro <lucas.kanashiro@canonical.com>  Mon, 24 Feb 2020 18:31:54 -0300
+
 ruby-defaults (1:2.5.7.1) unstable; urgency=medium
 
   * d/t/control: Make autopkgtests cross-test-friendly
@@ -21,6 +32,12 @@ ruby-defaults (1:2.5.7~0) experimental; urgency=medium
 
  -- Lucas Kanashiro <kanashiro@debian.org>  Wed, 27 Nov 2019 18:27:44 -0300
 
+ruby-defaults (1:2.5.2ubuntu1) focal; urgency=medium
+
+  * Make autopkgtests cross-test-friendly.
+
+ -- Steve Langasek <steve.langasek@ubuntu.com>  Tue, 21 Jan 2020 16:13:54 -0800
+
 ruby-defaults (1:2.5.2) unstable; urgency=medium
